spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence uses present continuous with always to express frustration?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] My roommate is always forgetting to buy milk. I have told him a hundred times.
B. [WRONG] My roommate always forgets to buy milk on Saturdays.
C. [WRONG] My roommate was always forgetting to buy milk when we shared a flat.
D. [WRONG] My roommate forgets to buy things every now and then.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: My roommate always forgets to buy milk on Saturdays., My roommate was always forgetting to buy milk when we shared a flat., My roommate forgets to buy things every now and then.
